turtles.itermcolors is copied unmodified from that commit's iterm2/. It is
the theme author's own iTerm2 export, so its 16 ANSI slots are authoritative
and correctly named, and unlike every other source outside the iTerm2
collection it also carries a real cursor and selection colour — nothing about
this scheme is seeded or derived.

LICENCE, read this before depending on it:

This repository declares no licence. It has no LICENSE file, and the badge in
its README is a copy-paste placeholder pointing at an unrelated repository
(mashape/apistatus), so it declares nothing despite appearing to. Every other
vendored source here names a real licence; this one is the exception, and it
is recorded as such rather than papered over.

It is vendored on the reading that bare colour values are facts rather than
creative expression — the same reasoning that made taking four values from
TangoTango's GPL-3.0 file low-risk — and on the owner's explicit decision to
include it. If upstream later declares a licence, update this file. If that
licence turns out to be incompatible, this is the one pack that has to go.

Read at build time by readItermColorsScheme in tools/external-scheme-sources.ts.
